WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano,
        CASE
            WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%' THEN 'Cancer de mama'
            WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%' THEN 'Cancer de prostata'
        END AS grupo,
        COUNT(*) AS internacoes
    FROM internacoes i
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023
      AND (
          i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%'
          OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%'
      )
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    ano,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN grupo = 'Cancer de mama' THEN internacoes END), 0) AS cancer_de_mama,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN grupo = 'Cancer de prostata' THEN internacoes END), 0) AS cancer_de_prostata
FROM base
GROUP BY ano
ORDER BY ano;
